summary: Phase 8 (UBOS Universal Business OS) — Universal Browse + Multi-tab workspace fully validated. 15/15 backend pytest tests pass (browse endpoint shape, filters, cursor pagination, sort, facets, field_defs bundle, RBAC/is_shared, view CRUD, openapi, performance, per-collection regression). Frontend E2E via Playwright confirms every requested flow works: /browse loads with 29 results in ~4ms took_ms, search narrows to 1 for 'Sarah', layout/facet/sort/views triggers all present, save-as-view creates & displays a new view, right-click context menu shows 2 items with correct testids, Ctrl-click opens without switching, X-close, Ctrl+Shift+T reopen, Ctrl+T/W keyboard shortcuts, sessionStorage persistence across reload, and MAX 20 TABS guard enforced (spammed 25 Ctrl+T → capped at exactly 20). Regression: /entity-types and /dashboard load cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: browse.py _facet_group has a dead first pipeline (immediately overwritten for the scalar case) — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
browse.py facets do not exclude the facet's own filter dimension (comment on line 232-234 acknowledges this MVP tradeoff) — count-broadening UX will be limited but works correctly for baseline case.
browse.py at line 155 relies on `r['entity_type_id']` being non-null; the code correctly guards elsewhere. No issue found in practice on seeded data.
The category descendant lookup issues one query per supplied category id (line 122-125); acceptable for MVP but could be batched with a single $in query.
The performance target (<300ms) is comfortably met — seeded dataset returned took_ms=4-7ms consistently.

seed_data_creation: Test browse-scope view 'TEST_EverythingRecent' created during UI flow and cleaned up post-run via DELETE /api/views/{id}. Pytest CRUD test creates+deletes its own 'TEST_ownerView' within a single test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8 baseline is green. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_ubos_phase8_browse.py (15 tests, pytest-xdist compatible). For any future Phase 8 changes, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ubos_phase8_browse.py -v. Browse endpoint is /api/records/browse (GET); browse-scope views live at /api/browse/views (GET/POST) and reuse /api/views/{id} for PATCH/DELETE. The frontend tab system uses sessionStorage (key ubos.tabs.*), max 20 tabs enforced, and useTabTitle hook is set on BrowsePage.
